1995.kid: A box that joins the room’s cables. Whatever comes in on one cable, it shouts out on all the others at once, and only the computer it’s for keeps it.
1995.nerd: A 10BASE-T repeater hub: it repeats every bit out of every other port as it arrives and reads nothing, so the whole room is one shared, half-duplex collision domain. Switches, which learn the port of each MAC address, took over in the late 1990s.
